Good afternoon, and here is the sports news. This morning, the international football congress was taking place in Lisbon. The delegates were discussing the new rules for players' agents when the breaking news arrived. A newspaper published an allegation about secret payments to a national federation. While the journalists were waiting outside the hall, the president of the congress stopped the meeting for thirty minutes. Later, a federation spokesperson read a short statement. She said the federation is taking the allegation seriously and will wait for the facts. She did not answer questions about the source of the story. The coverage was huge all afternoon, and the controversy is now the main topic in Lisbon. We will bring you more news at six o'clock.

Hi Nilo, it's Daniel, from the program group. I'm sorry I missed the coffee break this morning. I was waiting for my flight at the airport when I saw the headline about the club president on my phone. At first I thought it was a rumor, so I called the club's press office, because I wanted to check the source before I said anything to anybody. While I was talking to them, they published their official statement. So now we know it is real, but the allegation is still not proved. Listen, I think it's a perfect case for us. At the next session, I'd like to discuss it with you and the group, as a compliance case study. Call me back when you can. Bye.
